## About the Creator
A PvP Pack made by the youtuber Galactus/@Redstone_Master.

## About the Pack
This pack was created for [Quality Of Life | Essentials | Etc...] and is the 1st Version of the Galactus PvP Pack (2nd Version Coming Soon).

## Inside the pack
Lets go into the pack!

## GUI
Different colored hearts, Potato Hunger Bar, Darker Hotbar, Smoother Buttons

## Weapons
Smaller sword, Bow Colors, Smaller Shield, and Red Webs

## Font
The Font is smoother than the minecraft font making it more pleasing to the eyes and easier to read
